fixed_proposal.eligible_graph: edges (A label, B label) present in EVERY dwell with the SAME occupancy in every dwell; colour = that occupancy; computed from state_labels of every dwell
fixed_proposal.start: v0 uniform over the fixed original A+B roster (the same 128 labels as the cycle anchors / Birth / admission owners)
fixed_proposal.first_edge: uniform among viable eligible OCCUPIED edges at v0
fixed_proposal.continuation: uniform among viable eligible edges of the alternate colour at the current vertex (unoccupied after occupied and vice versa)
fixed_proposal.viability: LOOKAHEAD=True: far endpoint already visited, or has an eligible edge of the next required colour (one-step lookahead)
fixed_proposal.closure: first arrival at a visited vertex w; loop = closed part w..w (even length >=4, contractible or winding); tail v0..w not flipped
fixed_proposal.cap: MAX_WALK_STEPS=1024 tail+loop edges; reaching it without closure is a self loop (never binding at L4: a walk visits at most the 128+2*128 present vertices)
fixed_proposal.self_loops: empty start, dead end, cap, reverse walk impossible, transformed event replay guard/target failure; never resampled
fixed_proposal.flip: loop edges toggled in EVERY dwell through the labelled state and canonical_state_key; the key may change only in the incidence component, by the same mask in every dwell, equal to the union of the actual native positive-rate flip marks of the loop edges at the reference dwell
fixed_proposal.hastings: log MH = log(prod n_forward) - log(prod n_reverse) - sum dt (D_new - D_old) + sum log(W_new/W_old); reverse walk = same v0, same tail, loop reversed, recomputed on the transformed colouring
fixed_proposal.events: every stored event replayed with exact kind and owner; old target and stored W verified (inconsistency terminal), transformed target verified (failure = self loop), transformed W from the actual channel

choice_ledger.choice: tail not flipped; closure at first revisit
choice_ledger.reason: makes the reverse walk unique (same tail, reversed loop) so the Hastings factor is computable exactly; no loop erasure

choice_ledger.status: DECLARED; non-binding at L4 by the vertex bound
